interface BaseShape {
  value: number;
  read(this: Derived): number;
}
class Implementation {
  value = 1;
  constructor(input: string | number) { this.value = Number(input); }
  read(this: Derived) { return this.value + this.offset; }
}
type Numeric = { new(value: number): BaseShape };
type Textual = { new(value: string): { value: number; read(this: Derived): number } };
const Base: Numeric & Textual = Implementation;
class Derived extends (() => Base)() {
  offset = 2;
  run() { return super["read"](); }
}
class StaticBase {
  static get value() { return 3; }
  static asText(this: typeof StaticDerived) { return String(this.offset + this.value); }
}
class StaticDerived extends StaticBase {
  static offset = 5;
  static run() { return super["asText"](); }
}
class SetterBase {
  get count() { return this.current; }
  set count(value: number) { this.current = value; }
  current = 0;
}
class SetterDerived extends SetterBase {
  run() { super["count"] = 9; return super["count"]; }
}

console.log(new Derived(4).run(), new Derived("7").run(), StaticDerived.run(), new SetterDerived().run());
